data.title: Ethereum's "Proof Singularity": Real Technology, Inflated Narrative! EIP-8288
data.description: A genuine technical proposal, and a price prophecy that wrote itself. In the second week of September, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin posted a note titled "A note on recursive STARK mempools" — EIP-8288. On its face, this was an unremarkable engineering draft which move expensive cryptographic verification off the main chain and into the mempool, compressing it into a recursive STARK proof of a few hundred kilobyte...
